artyData.title: Specimen FSP issued with a Bde OO - notes
artyData.note: Specimen task table (Anx B to 4 Bde OO 1, form PAFB 6047; originator CO 57 (Fd Regt); fire plan HIT HARD in sp of 4 Bde, sers 1-30 by phase, tgt nos U1300-U4204) is a worked example and is not extracted. Its notes carry the planning rules and are kept here.

rows.text: FSP incl tasks for arty, air and inf wpns; forms part of bde OO so that all are info. Div OO does not normally contain consolidated div FSP. Div Fire Plan is a part of the Div Arty OO.
PAFB 6047 is the form used.
FSP is made by the sp arm comd. The originator is the arty comd.
H hr is essential. It may be given later or FSP kept on call.
Each tgt is a separate serial even if they are being engaged at the same time. This helps in modifications.
For this op, two bdes are attacking simultaneously; 4 Bde has been altd two fd regts, one med regt and one mor bty, out of which 4 Fd is in DS and 83 Med is at pri call to GSO 2 (ICB).
FSP is made by phs and not by units. Ph 1 is normally a timed progm; subsequent phs may be On Call.
When tgt list is not issued separately this may show tgt GR, ht and description. GR must be given; description is optional.
Air strikes if aval should be used before start of arty progm.
Prep bombardment is not always nec.
One min gap should be given b/w different sers if rate of fire is higher than normal.
Two btys of 57 Fd Regt which are DS fd btys of 1 and 2 Baloch (attacking bns) have to remain aval for engagement of impromptu tgts by FOOs and have been superimposed throughout.
83 Med is at pri call to GSO2 (ICB), hence all its btys have been superimposed throughout.

Only those tgts should be neut which can eff interfere with own aslt tps. A tgt should not normally be within 300 ms of another tgt. Meds and mors should be kept on flanks or in depth, whenever possible, to avoid their lifting earlier than fd guns.
Tgts which may interfere with aslt may be kept on call.
No ltd is laid on the no of DFs sel but gen 12 to 16 per bn front covering likely apchs are enough.
No ltd is laid on the no of DFs sel but gen 6 to 8 per bn front covering likely apchs are enough.
rows.note2: (q) and (r) are printed with the same wording but different figures; the book does not say what distinguishes them.

rows.text: Depending upon the eqpt met msgs are prep either by electronic method or by vis method.
Electronic method is more accurate but is costly.
Vis method provides adequate accuracy and is cheap.
Normally it takes 30 mins with electronic method to set up the eqpt and begin obsns. Subsequently 30 mins are req in both the cases to formulate the met msgs.
A regt svy sec normally takes 60 to 90 mins during day to bring the regt, depl in one sq (1000x1000 ms), on one grid. Normal svy during day takes one hr for every one thousand ms.
A div svy normally takes 6 to 8 hrs of day. It brings the div arty on one grid provided the units are depl in adjacent gun areas. Time will inc proportionately if the gun areas are dispersed.
During ni, time taken for svy is gen doubled.
A long base of 4 OPs can range in depth upto ltds of vis and in width from 6000 ms to 10,000 ms. It takes 4 to 6 hrs to depl excl the traveling time to the dep area.
A short base of 2 OPs can be depl in one hr but covers a dist of only 1000 ms in width and is, therefore, resorted to only under exceptional circumstances.
This method affords loc of hostile guns to an accuracy of 100 yds or 92 ms. Mtn terrain, very fast wind, B fd noises and simultaneous firing by a large no of en guns reduce its eff considerably.
A std long base stretches over a dist of 6752 ms and takes 6 to 8 hrs to depl excl travelling time to the depl area.
A std short base extends over a dist of 2026 ms and takes 2 to 4 hrs to depl excl the travelling time to the depl area.

The farthest ltd of sound rg is governed by the intensity of sound produced by the en gun. The accuracy, however, deteriorates at extreme ranges. 100 Ms accuracy is obtained upto a depth of 10128 ms with a std long base and upto 5064 ms with a std short base.

The present eqpt can loc arty guns/mors/msls up to the range of 50 kms with an accuracy of 10 ms or 1 percent of the accuracy of the loc wpn, which ever is greater. It is virtually unjammable and can simultaneously loc 99 tgts. It is less affected by adverse weather conditions.
